title: Chorani—or Choranit
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan ben ha-Chorani ([Mishnah Sukkah 2:7](https://www.sefaria.org/Mishnah_Sukkah.2.7)), and in [Eruvin 13b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.13b.12) the reading is "ben ha-Choranit."[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Hebrew of the Mishnah reads ha-Chorani; the linked Bavli has ha-Choranit in its retelling of the same visit.
[Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1812&lang=en) uses the ha-Choranit form and cites both passages.
